title: Introduction to Java
text: Java is an object-oriented programming language. It uses classes, objects, methods and variables. Java is commonly used to build backend applications and enterprise software.

title: Object-Oriented Programming
text: Object-oriented programming organizes software using classes and objects. Important principles include encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and abstraction.

title: Understanding HTTP
text: HTTP is a protocol used for communication between clients and servers. Requests use methods such as GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. Responses include status codes such as 200 and 404.

title: REST API Fundamentals
text: A REST API exposes resources through HTTP endpoints. Clients use HTTP methods to retrieve, create, update and delete resources. REST commonly uses JSON for data exchange.

title: Introduction to SQL
text: SQL is used to manage relational databases. SELECT retrieves data, INSERT adds records, UPDATE modifies records and DELETE removes records. JOIN combines related tables.

title: Java Database Connectivity
text: JDBC allows Java applications to communicate with relational databases. Developers can execute SQL statements using JDBC connections and prepared statements.

title: MVC Architecture
text: Model View Controller separates applications into three responsibilities. The Model manages data and business logic, the View handles presentation and the Controller processes requests.

title: Spring Boot Fundamentals
text: Spring Boot is a Java framework for building web applications and REST APIs. It provides dependency injection, automatic configuration and integration with databases.
